quotes: [PMID:38762484] [SUPPORT] The interaction of PD-1 and PD-L1 negatively regulates adaptive immune response mainly by inhibiting the activity of effector T cells while enhancing the function of immunosuppressive regulatory T cells (Tregs), largely contributing to the maintenance of immune homeostasis that prevents dysregulated immunity and harmful immune responses. steps.label: Treatment-Emergent Vasoconstriction and Increased Peripheral Vascular Resistance

**Summary**  
Patient C3N-00310 has a GNN-A out-of-fold risk estimate of 58% for stage III–IV ccRCC.
